summary.intent: Add a new GSD todo to track running testing scripts against staging and recording performance baselines/metrics after recent metrics instrumentation was deployed.
summary.outcome: Created a new pending todo file for running staging metrics baselines and updated STATE.md with the incremented todo count.

repo: cipher-box uses a .planning/todos/pending/ directory for tracking pending work items as markdown files with date-prefixed slugs
STATE.md tracks aggregate todo counts and can become stale across sessions
workflow: Todo slugs are generated programmatically from a description before writing the file
Duplicate todo checks are performed before creation
Todo creation and STATE.md updates are committed together as a single atomic commit

friction: STATE.md had a stale todo count from a previous session (showed 10 but actual was 6), causing an incorrect count of 14 before being caught and corrected to 10
open_items: Run testing scripts against staging environment to capture performance baselines with the new metrics instrumentation in place
Update any timing/metric values that need adjustment based on staging results
